title: UNLIMITED Free AI Coding Credits?
description:
https://github.com/diegosouzapw/OmniRoute

This might be one of the closest things to nearly unlimited free AI for coding.

Instead of giving you its own AI model, this open-source tool connects the free usage offered by dozens of different providers and puts it behind one gateway.

You can connect that gateway to tools like Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor. Then, when one provider reaches its limit, OmniRoute can automatically send your next request to another provider that still has free usage available.

According to the project, it currently supports more than 90 providers with some form of free access. You can start with the options already supported, then connect other free plans, accounts, or API keys you already use.

The important distinction is that OmniRoute isn't magically making the best ChatGPT or Claude models free. The model handling your work may change, and so can the speed, quality, privacy rules, and amount of free usage available.

But for prototypes, smaller coding tasks, or anyone willing to trade some consistency for much lower costs, this could keep an AI coding session going for a very long time without paying.
